layouts.name: Macao RX
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Standard lap, Joker lap. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Standard lap
layouts.description: Standard lap follows the outer southern return in the federation event plan, retaining the eastern infield hairpin. Public mapping is coarse; distance and direction remain draft.

layouts.name: Joker lap
layouts.description: Joker lap follows the alternate inner southern return shown separately in the federation event plan, retaining the same eastern infield hairpin. Public mapping is coarse; distance and direction remain draft.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The general rallycross entry includes the standard southern return and alternate joker connection shown in the federation plan, page 7. Exact independently mapped course nodes form both closed laps. The public sport tag is inaccurate: the primary federation document identifies the facility as rallycross. No pit or paddock access is included. The independent unique branch distance is 971.4 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
